name: Moonlit Sans
status: project-original prior font; retained as a comparison and numeral source

design.brief: A compact, friendly humanist bitmap sans for Shiren GB dialogue and menus.
design.inspiration: Small-screen humanist bitmap typography, including Espy Sans Revived, without copying its glyph outlines or font data.
design.constraints: Every advance and final painted extent is no wider than the previously approved Dot Gothic Shiren glyph.
design.authorship: Original glyph drawings created for the Shiren GB English patch in 2026.

source.name: Moonlit Sans 8x8 glyph rows
source.provenance: Drawn from scratch for this repository; contains no third-party font file or extracted glyph data.
